bio: Dirkjan and Hilde warmly welcome guests to their stylish establishment depicted by a cosy, tranquil vibe and flanked by an exquisite patio. Chef Decock enthusiastically gets on with the job in his open-plan kitchen. He works with top-notch ingredients, creatively preparing vegetables and also adding the odd hint of exoticism to jazz up the dishes. Stripped-back, subtle and fascinating food....
